I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Totally get wanting to keep costs in check—there are a few budget‑friendly ways to enjoy our food:
Try before subscribing: Grab our Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon, or single packs from PetSmart, so you can test recipes without a commitment.
Shop retail instead of subscribing: You can buy our full recipes through PetSmart (online and select stores), Amazon, and Chewy.
Tailor your subscription cost: Your price depends on things like number of dogs, their size, activity, and recipes. Our Pet Support team can give you a custom quote so you can see what fits your budget.
Adjust how much you feed via your meal plan: In your account’s Pets page, you can tweak recipes, recipe options, and portion sizes (like mixing Nom Nom with other food using smaller portions) so the plan better matches your budget.
Check for discounts if eligible: First Responders and Military Veterans can apply for a discount on orders through our Pet Support team.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
